## Checklist

- [ ] Behavior changes go through an OpenSpec change (`openspec/changes/<name>/`), as described in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `dotnet test DBUDoctor.slnx` passes
- [ ] New rule: `docs/rules/DBU0xx.md`, a fixture bundle, and the regenerated agent skill (`dbudoctor skill export --dir skills/dbudoctor --force`)
- [ ] Price or catalog change: the source and the date it was checked
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md **Unreleased** updated for user-visible changes
